elements.name: ssfds 6
elements.text: Evaluate while the auditing whether or not the following are acceptable (check yes or no)

elements.name: Texto 6
elements.text: Employees correctly wash hands and at required times

elements.name: Texto 7
elements.text: No unsecured jewelry or loose objects are present in exposed-food areas.

elements.name: Texto 8
elements.text: Fingernails are free of polish or artificial nails.

elements.name: Texto 5
elements.text: Smocks are clean, in good condition, and worn correctly.

elements.name: Texto 9
elements.text: Hairnets and beard are being worn and fully cover hair where required.

elements.name: Texto 10
elements.text: Good personnel hygiene is practiced; no strong cologne or perfume is evident.

elements.name: Texto 11
elements.text: No signs of eating, drinking, smoking, chewing, or spitting are observed.

elements.name: Texto 11
elements.text: No false eyelashes or in exposed-food areas.

elements.name: Texto 11
elements.text: No Visible Signs of Infectious Disease, Major Uncovered Cuts or Lesions are observed.

elements.name: Texto 11
elements.text: Minor cuts are fully covered with a metal-detectable bandage and glove.

elements.name: Texto 12
elements.text: Pedestrian and forklift/pallet-jack traffic is controlled and follows proper routes.

elements.name: Texto 12
elements.text: Open product, ingredients, materials, and packaging are covered and stored off the floor.

elements.name: Texto 12
elements.text: Doors Closed and Not Kept Open for Extended Periods of Time

elements.name: Texto 12
elements.text: No unauthorize glass, brittle plastic, or ceramic is present.

elements.name: Texto 12
elements.text: Air Hoses & Wash Down Water Hoses Stored on Racks off Floor

elements.name: Texto 12
elements.text: Hairnets, Gloves, and Disposable Aprons Disposed of Prior to Leaving Facility

elements.name: Texto 12
elements.text: No unauthorized temporary repairs are present on food-contact or non-food-contact equipmen

elements.name: Texto 4
elements.text: Required gloves are worn correctly and changed when needed.

elements.name: Texto 13
elements.text: Food contact utensils show no visibile signs of wearing

elements.name: Texto 26
elements.text: 1945 TEMPERATURE & % RELATIVE HUMIDITY MONITORING (FREQUENCY: BEGINNING-MIDDLE-END OF THE SHIFT)

elements.name: Texto 27
elements.text: Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs)- Everywhere Food is Exposed
